summary_markdown: A review of draft release notes was conducted. Specifically, a use case description regarding frame updates needed correction. The initial note stated that an auditor could only restore the last *approved* version if an incorrect update was made to a frame. [p12] corrected this, noting that rollback is possible to *any* previous version, not just approved ones. This change was accepted by [p8].
decisions: The release notes use case description regarding frame rollbacks must be updated to reflect the ability to restore to any version.
action_items: [p8] will update the release notes and push them out for final review.
